Subject: Exec runway sync — QBR asks & outstanding product clarifications

Hi team,

Thanks for joining the short runway sync this morning. Per the exec follow-up, we need a crisp list of outstanding product clarifications and any roadmap exceptions that should be surfaced in the QBR on 9/14.

Attached: QBR_runway_deck_v2.pdf (deck for exec), MAL-ask-tracker.xlsx (working tracker)

Please respond with: 1) short status (green/amber/red), 2) blocker(s), 3) owner and ETA. I'll consolidate and raise anything that needs exec attention.

Initial asks I captured:
- Model quantization guidance for latency SLOs (priority: exec ask)
- Dedicated capacity horizon for EU regions (possible procurement lead time)
- Rollout plan for caching changes (risk of regressions)

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Sr. Product Manager, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Thanks Mina — quick updates below.

- Quantization guidance: Amber. Research has a recommended 8-bit path, but we need perf validation on long-context Llama-variants. Owner: lauren.bishop. ETA: 9/13 for perf results.
- Caching rollout: Green for canary, but need a rollback playbook. Owner: karthik.iyer. ETA: 9/10 for playbook.

Question: can procurement confirm an optimistic vs conservative lead time for dedicated GPU pools for EU? If it's >8 weeks we should flag for exec.

—Lauren
